description: A single flowchart-style composite figure (Fig. 1) that maps the yield-strength (YS) prediction framework, built from six dashed-outline modules joined by labelled arrows ("Model selection", "Algorithm optimization", "Experimental verification", "Feature filtering"). Top-left module: a grid of algorithm abbreviations (DT, KNN, XGB, CatB, ET, LGBM, AdaB) with "ET selected" below it, plus an inset "Extra Trees Fitting Performance" scatter plot (Actual Values/MPa vs Predicted Values/MPa) whose point cloud lies along the diagonal, blue points and a pink trend line. Top-right module, "GA optimized ET (GA-ET)", shows five schematic decision trees with red and white nodes separated by "...", and prints R²=0.997, RMSE=31.6, MAPE=4.39% on pink tabs. Middle-left module pairs a purple-dot/red-star scatter with three blue text boxes: "177 original data training model", "Data enhancement using GMM method", "Capture features, data expansion 599". Middle-right module places an engineering stress–strain plot (x: Engineering Strain/%, y: Engineering Stress/MPa, ticks to ~1400; annotated "Air cooling"; small pale-blue inset legend) beside a grouped/box bar chart (x: three annealing conditions; y: YS(MPa); legend "Data Train" red, "GA-ETs Train" blue) with the note "GA-ET has the best performance". Bottom module "Feature filtering" lists Dislocation, Fine grain, Solid solution and Orowan strengthening with σ_YS = σ_0 + σ_g + σ_d + σ_Orowan.

subfigures.description: Dashed module listing six learning algorithms (DT, KNN, XGB, CatB, LGBM, AdaB) with the label 'ET selected', plus an inset scatter titled 'Extra Trees Fitting Performance' (Actual Values/MPa vs Predicted Values/MPa) showing points tightly along the diagonal.

Dashed module labelled 'GA optimized ET (GA-ET)' containing five schematic decision-tree diagrams with red internal nodes and white leaf nodes, separated by '...', and three printed metrics: R²=0.997, RMSE=31.6, MAPE=4.39%.

Dashed module with a 2D feature scatter (purple dots, red stars, one green star) and three text boxes reading '177 original data training model', 'Data enhancement using GMM method' and 'Capture features, data expansion 599'; an arrow labelled 'Model selection' leaves it toward the algorithm module.

Engineering stress–strain curve: x-axis 'Engineering Strain/%', y-axis 'Engineering Stress/MPa' with ticks to about 1400, text annotation 'Air cooling', multiple coloured curves and a small inset fitting-performance legend that is too small to read.

Grouped bar/box chart with y-axis 'YS(MPa)' (ticks 0, 20, 40) for three x-axis conditions, red bars labelled 'Data Train' and blue bars labelled 'GA-ETs Train'; the blue GA-ETs bars are higher, matching the note 'GA-ET has the best performance'.

Dashed module 'Feature filtering' containing four coloured boxes — Dislocation strengthening, Fine grain strengthening, Solid solution strengthening, Orowan strengthening — and the equation σ_YS = σ_0 + σ_g + σ_d + σ_Orowan.
Text block reading '177 pieces of original data were collected from the existing literature, including four strengthening mechanisms and YS', with an arrow into the data-enhancement module.

Text block describing verification methods: (1) low-density steel annealed at different temperatures prepared by air cooling, with strengthening-mechanism contribution values and YS measured; (2) ten validation sets constructed from literature data for prediction and error analysis. Text is cropped at the right edge.

observations.observation: The figure is a process flowchart of six dashed-outline modules connected by four labelled arrows: 'Model selection', 'Algorithm optimization', 'Experimental verification' and 'Feature filtering'.
The model-selection module lists the candidate algorithms DT, KNN, XGB, CatB, ET, LGBM and AdaB, and indicates 'ET selected'.
An inset scatter titled 'Extra Trees Fitting Performance' plots Actual Values/MPa against Predicted Values/MPa with points lying along the diagonal.
The GA-ET module prints three performance metrics: R²=0.997, RMSE=31.6 and MAPE=4.39%.
The data-preparation module states '177 original data training model' and 'Capture features, data expansion 599', with 'Data enhancement using GMM method'.

The 'Feature filtering' module names the four mechanisms used (Dislocation strengthening, Fine grain strengthening, Solid solution strengthening, Orowan strengthening) and gives the superposition equation σ_YS = σ_0 + σ_g + σ_d + σ_Orowan.
A text block on the left states '177 pieces of original data were collected from the existing literature, including four strengthening mechanisms and YS'.
The stress–strain panel is annotated 'Air cooling' and uses axes Engineering Strain/% (x) and Engineering Stress/MPa (y) with y ticks up to about 1400.
The bar panel compares 'Data Train' (red) with 'GA-ETs Train' (blue) for three annealing conditions on a YS(MPa) axis, and the panel is annotated 'GA-ET has the best performance'.

A right-hand text block states the verification methods: (1) low-density steel with different annealing temperatures prepared by air cooling, with strengthening-mechanism contributions and YS measured; (2) ten validation sets constructed from literature data for prediction and error analysis.
The caption states that Fig. 1 is a 'Flowchart of the yield strength prediction framework'.

The citing text states that the framework integrates quantitative contribution data of four core strengthening mechanisms, uses GMM for data expansion, and applies an ensemble-learning algorithm to map strengthening mechanisms to yield strength.
